title: Assistant Professor of Business Administration
bio: What Sets Successful Product Launches Apart? Savvy Store Managers When evaluating a new product launch, companies typically weigh factors like price and promotion. New research suggests adding another element: people. A study of new product rollouts at a major Colombian retailer found that managerial quality strongly influences a new product’s success. Retailers should take account this unlikely source of friction in the product rollout process—differences in the skills of managers on the ground—that might make a product seem more or less promising than its true potential.
